_about: What ArtCraft Quick Look takes from elsewhere, at which version, and where its new versions appear. check-dependencies.py of roccobot.github.io (.memo/scripts), run from this repo's root, compares the version in use (RENDERERS in scripts/prepare_renderers.py, the one place it is written with its SHA-256) with the latest release on GitHub, pre-releases included and nightly builds excluded ("channel": "any"): every renderer is taken at its latest version, betas too (Rules.md, 'Le dipendenze'); a newer one is read for what is worth bringing in before it is taken (Roccobot.md, 'Le dipendenze si seguono'). The weekly workflow .github/workflows/dependencies.yml runs it every Monday. SVG files use the VectorCraft renderer. A new renderer comes in with its version and the SHA-256 of its macos-universal ZIP in RENDERERS, the version in the two READMEs, and a build tried on the Mac.
